description: Search Paylo's own guides and comparison articles from the usepaylo.com blog. Use it when someone wants a fuller explanation than a tool result can give: how escrow and buyer protection work, selling online in Nigeria, same-day delivery, pay on delivery, Shop for me errands, POS, staff and inventory management, or Paylo pricing. Each result returns the title, link, published and updated dates, a short summary and tags. It never returns the article body, so cite the link for the full guide.

query.description: Free text over guide title, summary and tags, e.g. 'escrow', 'pay on delivery', 'pricing'. Omit to get the newest guides.

name: search_guides
